Forecasting baseline
====================

A linear trend with an uncertainty interval is the baseline for HELIX numeric
forecasting. The baseline is fitted by ordinary least squares on a chronological
split; the last portion of the series is held out for scoring.

Reported error uses mean absolute error and root mean squared error on the
holdout. An interval is reported as a 90 percent prediction interval derived
from the residual standard error. A forecast without a stated horizon and
baseline is not a verified prediction.
